boundaries: A workspace has one primary Project in this proposed profile; Product references are optional where the Project pursues another explicit purpose.
A Project, Goal, Work item, Person or Team record does not automatically become another workspace.
Distinct semantic owners and independently recoverable homes remain distinct even inside one workspace.
The parent owns inherited contracts; local changes stay inside explicit extension scope.
Unqualified Lab instance is not an alias here: use Lab Workspace for the durable modeled scope and runtime installation/instance for execution.
A workspace can remain proposed with no installation or actual adoption outcome; preparation, schema validity and profile replay grant no authority.

working_meaning.scope: The proposed durable operating scope connecting one primary Project to selected Lab model capabilities, local records and referenced package homes.
working_meaning.statement: A Lab Workspace is a durable, versioned operating scope for one explicitly identified primary Project, binding its locally owned records and referenced canonical package homes to an exact reusable Lab operating-model revision through a Model Instance Binding. It declares purpose, scope and exclusions, accountable routes, applicable contracts, local configuration and extension limits, source selections, lifecycle and challenge handling. Workspace identity remains separate from Project and Product identity, semantic context, canonical package home, repository location, runtime installation and authority grants. Location, hosting and model upgrades do not by themselves replace its identity or transfer ownership.
